findings.claim: The proposed bootstrap module name `NaruServe` equals rootProject.name 'NaruServe', and the root build.gradle sets group in allprojects, so the root project and :NaruServe both carry com.snoworca.naruserve:NaruServe. Any build that consumes the root build through includeBuild (D-364 samples/android) then fails to resolve the bootstrap: Gradle reports 'Module version ... is not unique in composite'. Reproduced with Gradle 8.14.3 in a minimal composite (root 'Foo' + subproject ':Foo', allprojects group 'g'; consumer dependency g:Foo:1 failed with exactly that error).
findings.suggested_fix: When wave 1 fixes the names in #1, either give the bootstrap module a name different from the root project, rename the root project, or set group/version only on subprojects; add a note to D-002 so the choice is checked against D-364 composite consumption.

findings.claim: The wave design says integration items I-001..I-021 all hold at this wave's merge. Several cannot hold at wave 1: I-009 needs every JVM Java example in docs/api/ to compile, but those examples use RestApp/Request/Response, which wave 1 does not create. I-011 needs configuration classes. I-018/I-019 are end-of-run gates. I-021 depends on D-052/D-442 from later waves. I-002/I-005 need automated checks that no wave-1 item asks for. Read literally, the wave-1 merge gate cannot be met.
findings.suggested_fix: Limit the wave-1 merge statement to the integration items that apply at that point (I-001, I-003, I-004, I-006, I-008, I-013, I-014, plus I-002/I-005 only if wave 1 adds those checks), and say the rest apply once their subject exists or at run close.

findings.claim: D-029 says wave 1 removes every (미확정) module-name marker in docs/api/, but it names only five files. docs/api/servlet.md:11 has a (미확정) marker for a separate jakarta.servlet module. D-358 (wave 8) settles that differently ('no jakarta.servlet module in v1'), and #1 does not fix it, so wave 1 can neither meet 'every' nor justify editing servlet.md under D-029.
findings.suggested_fix: Limit D-029 to the module-name markers of the modules fixed in #1 (README.md:93,99, json.md:47, kotlin.md:99, logging.md:83). Leave the jakarta marker in servlet.md to wave 8 / D-358.

findings.claim: D-013/D-014 point every git worktree at the same TinyHttpd checkout through includeBuild. Included-build task outputs go into that checkout (core/build, websocket/build, .gradle). Parallel wave workers building at the same time in different worktrees therefore compile into the same output directories, which risks races and lock timeouts. The outputs are gitignored, so I-006 still holds, but builds become nondeterministic.
findings.suggested_fix: Record in wave 1 docs that worker builds either run serially, or set the TinyHttpd property per worktree to a private read-only copy (e.g. a git worktree/clone of TinyHttpd at 46b973e). The original checkout stays unmodified either way.

findings.claim: D-448 updates only the CLAUDE.md module line, but CLAUDE.md:38 still names the Kotlin module `rest-kotlin`, and docs/api/kotlin.md:97 uses the heading 'rest-kotlin 선택 확장' (not a (미확정) marker). After #1 fixes the name (proposed NaruServe-kotlin), both places are stale.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend D-448/D-029 so they also replace the `rest-kotlin` mentions with the fixed Kotlin module name.

findings.claim: D-017 lets only the adapter module depend on TinyHttpd, and the bootstrap depends on the adapter (D-228). If the adapter declares TinyHttpd with `api`, TinyHttpd lands on the bootstrap's compile classpath, which breaks the type confinement of D-209.
findings.suggested_fix: State that the adapter declares tinyhttpd-core/tinyhttpd-websocket with `implementation` scope.
